translations.web: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
translations.bsb: and longing to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.
translations.kjv: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
translations.asv: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man's table; yea, even the dogs come and licked his sores.
